description: Self-hosted form builder for Laravel, shipped as a Filament plugin. Visual builder, 25+ field types, conditional logic, multi-step forms, submissions, analytics, and notifications inside your own application.
rules: FilaForms installs as a Filament plugin with FilaFormsPlugin::make(); it is not a hosted service and has no cloud version.
Forms are built visually in the Filament panel. Do not write a Filament schema by hand to create a FilaForms form.
Every submission dispatches FilaForms\Core\Events\FormSubmitted with readonly $form and $submission properties.
Submitted values live on $submission->data, which is cast to an array. Uploaded files are stored on the configured filesystem disk, so data holds paths.
Form and FormSubmission models use ULID primary keys.
Public forms resolve through the packaged filaforms.public.show route; build links with getFormUrl() rather than by hand.
